# TPC-DS-OBT Q31

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH ss AS (SELECT obt.bill_addr_ca_county AS ca_county, obt.sold_date_d_qoy AS d_qoy, obt.sold_date_d_year AS d_year, SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS store_sales FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.ship_addr_sk = obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk) AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year), ws AS (SELECT obt.bill_addr_ca_county AS ca_county, obt.sold_date_d_qoy AS d_qoy, obt.sold_date_d_year AS d_year, SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS web_sales FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.bill_addr_sk = obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk) AND channel = 'web' GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year) SELECT ss1.ca_county, ss1.d_year, CAST(ws2.web_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ws1.web_sales, 0) AS web_q1_q2_increase, CAST(ss2.store_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ss1.store_sales, 0) AS store_q1_q2_increase, CAST(ws3.web_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ws2.web_sales, 0) AS web_q2_q3_increase, CAST(ss3.store_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ss2.store_sales, 0) AS store_q2_q3_increase FROM ss AS ss1, ss AS ss2, ss AS ss3, ws AS ws1, ws AS ws2, ws AS ws3 WHERE ss1.d_qoy = 1 AND ss1.d_year = 1998 AND ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county AND ss2.d_qoy = 2 AND ss2.d_year = 1998 AND ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county AND ss3.d_qoy = 3 AND ss3.d_year = 1998 AND ss1.ca_county = ws1.ca_county AND ws1.d_qoy = 1 AND ws1.d_year = 1998 AND ws1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county AND ws2.d_qoy = 2 AND ws2.d_year = 1998 AND ws1.ca_county = ws3.ca_county AND ws3.d_qoy = 3 AND ws3.d_year = 1998 AND CASE WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0 THEN CAST(ws2.web_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ws1.web_sales, 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0 THEN CAST(ss2.store_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ss1.store_sales, 0) ELSE NULL END AND CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0 THEN CAST(ws3.web_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ws2.web_sales, 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0 THEN CAST(ss3.store_sales AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(ss2.store_sales, 0) ELSE NULL END ORDER BY ss1.ca_county
```
